title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Night With Just The Three Of Us〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: A Night With Just The Three Of Us（2★）
meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yup, I'm all fueled up♪
How about you, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I literally just got back from having dinner.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's ten til 25:00, so I'm sure she'll be here in about five minutes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Ena's been logging in later and later recently...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<About Enanan...
She hasn't been logging in early at all lately.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, freaky...
I was just thinking the same thing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And I was wondering if she's... Well...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's like she always logs into Nightcord right at 25:00 whenever she's really having trouble with an illustration, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, I see a correlation as well...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And when she's really in a slump, she hardly ever speaks even when she's online.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She's probably telling herself to finish drawing faster somehow...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I think I know what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <On the flip side, she'll talk nonstop whenever she's on a roll or feels good about what she's drawn.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In Enanan's case, a picture's only worth a thousand words only when she's able to draw the darn thing, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Uh, swing and a miss...?
That joke sounded funnier in my head...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How a picture's worth a thousand words.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But in Enanan's case, her ability to talk is dependent on whether or not she's drawn said picture...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<U-Um, Yuki...
Can I die from embarrassment now that you've thoroughly dissected my joke?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry, Amia.
It's my fault for not getting it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I can't really crack jokes like that without Ena and her reactions...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I-In any case, we've established that Enanan's mood varied depending on how her illustrations are going.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Wouldn't it be better for her to focus on her art instead of talking so much...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Ngh...!
You're so right that it pains me to hear it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Enanan!
Did school get out late today?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I was working offline and got so focused that I lost track of what time it was...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's okay. I do the same thing from time to time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's see how we're all doing...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She said she wants to focus and put herself on mute until 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She said yesterday that she's gonna have her draft ready by today, so does that mean everything's going okay for her?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, can I have a minute before we do...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm kinda stuck thinking about what to do with the rough draft for our next song. Mind taking a look at it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Times like these, it's easier for us to come up with ideas when we put our heads together.)
